summary: Frontend-only regression test of Sri Lanka restoration + Careers/Open Positions iframe flow. All requested features pass. One minor site-wide 4px horizontal overflow at 768px coming from the Diwali Sale announcement bar (not open-positions specific).

issues: Document scrollWidth=772 vs clientWidth=768 — 4px horizontal overflow caused by the sitewide Diwali Sale banner <span class='group/sale relative inline-flex'>. Minor, cosmetic.

test_results.sri_lanka_listing: PASS - /asia/sri-lanka → /asia/sri-lanka/holidays, H1 'Sri Lanka tours & holidays', 'Browse 34 package ideas', 0 broken images, 36 unique image srcs (not identical)
test_results.sri_lanka_detail_pages: PASS - all 4 detail pages render H1, price, breadcrumb link to /asia/sri-lanka, day tabs, no console errors
test_results.sri_lanka_detail_lead_modal: PASS - clicking data-testid=eg-detail-price-cta on /asia/sri-lanka-weekend-island-break-bentota-and-colombo opens dye-modal with 'Sri Lanka holiday' and dye-image-destination visible
test_results.homepage_top10: PASS - Top 10 labels: Europe, Japan, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Bali, Bhutan, Thailand, Singapore, China, Egypt (contains Sri Lanka, no Kazakhstan)
test_results.homepage_asia_tab: PASS - Sri Lanka card linking to /asia/sri-lanka (not 'Coming soon'). Kazakhstan still present in Asia tab (expected)
test_results.homepage_search_srilanka: PASS - typing 'Sri' in destination search returns Sri Lanka
test_results.asia_holidays_aggregate: PASS - Country facet shows 'Sri Lanka (34)' on /asia/holidays
test_results.footer_srilanka: PASS - footer anchor a[href=/asia/sri-lanka] present on homepage
test_results.careers_page: PASS - data-testid=careers-hero present; data-testid=careers-hero-positions present and navigates to /careers/open-positions; Learn more button present; values/perks/awards sections present. Note: one empty <iframe> (no src) exists on /careers — likely a hidden placeholder (not Recruit CRM, which uses recruitcrm.io src)
test_results.careers_mobile_sticky: PASS - data-testid=careers-sticky-positions visible at 390px and navigates to /careers/open-positions
test_results.open_positions_page: PASS - site header + footer present; data-testid=open-positions-title='Open Positions'; data-testid=open-positions-back href=/careers; data-testid=open-positions-iframe src starts with https://recruitcrm.io/jobs/Hi_Tours_Group_jobs; 7 'View Job Description' buttons inside the frame; data-testid=open-positions-all NOT present initially
test_results.open_positions_horizontal_scroll: PASS at 1920/390; MINOR 4px overflow at 768 caused by the sitewide Diwali Sale banner, not the Open Positions content itself
test_results.open_positions_all_button_flow: PASS - clicking 'View Job Description' inside iframe makes data-testid=open-positions-all appear to the LEFT of 'Back to Careers' (all_left=1233.69 < back_left=1399.5); clicking it keeps URL at /careers/open-positions, the button disappears, iframe reloads with 7 'View Job Description' buttons visible again
test_results.care_cta_lead_modal_regression: PASS - data-testid=care-hero-cta opens dye-image-destination lead modal with 'Worry-free holiday'
test_results.sitemap: PASS - sitemap.xml contains /careers/open-positions (1) and 35 unique /asia/*sri-lanka* URLs (/asia/sri-lanka + 34 detail pages)
test_results.console_errors: No console errors from Hi Tours app. Expected noise from inside Recruit CRM iframe (RSC payload warning + 404s originating at recruitcrm.io) — third-party, out of scope

action_items: (Optional/minor) Investigate 4px horizontal overflow at 768px caused by the Diwali Sale announcement bar span — site-wide, not open-positions specific.
(Optional) /careers has one empty <iframe> element with no src — if unused, consider removing to keep the markup clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To open the lead modal from a Sri Lanka detail page use data-testid=eg-detail-price-cta (shared Egypt-style template); the raw <a href='/l/.../enquiry/passengers/'> is a fallback-only route and renders blank if hit directly — the click handler intercepts and opens the dye-modal in-place, confirmed working. For the Recruit CRM iframe flow, click 'View Job Description' via page.frame_locator('[data-testid=open-positions-iframe]') (NOT via JS dispatch) — the 'All Open Positions' button appears via window blur when focus moves into the cross-origin iframe.
